commands.name: Noop
commands.description: No-op. Increments command counter.

commands.name: Reset Counters
commands.description: Reset ES command counters.

commands.name: Restart
commands.description: Restart the cFE (processor or power-on reset).

commands.name: Start App
commands.description: Dynamically load and start an application.

params.name: Application
params.description: Short name used internally for registration

params.name: AppFileName
params.description: Full path to the shared-object file

params.name: ExceptionAction
params.description: Action on exception. RESTART_APP: restarts the App, PROC_RESTART: perform processor reboot.

commands.name: Stop App
commands.description: Halt and unload a running application.

params.name: Application
params.description: Name of the app to stop

commands.name: Restart App
commands.description: Stop and immediately restart an application.

params.name: Application
params.description: Name of the app to restart

commands.name: Reload App
commands.description: Stop an app, then start it from a (possibly different) file.

params.name: Application
params.description: Name of the running app to reload

commands.name: Query One
commands.description: Request a single-app info telemetry packet.

commands.name: Query All
commands.description: Write all loaded-app info to a file.

commands.name: Clear Syslog
commands.description: Erase the ES system log buffer.

commands.name: Write Syslog to File
commands.description: Dump the ES system log to a file.

commands.name: Clear ER Log
commands.description: Erase the Exception and Reset log.

commands.name: Write ER Log to File
commands.description: Dump the ER log to a file.

commands.name: Start Perf Data
commands.description: Start performance data collection.

params.name: TriggerMode
params.description: Trigger position in the ring buffer

commands.name: Stop Perf Data
commands.description: Stop performance data collection and write to file.

commands.name: Set Perf Filter Mask
commands.description: Set a performance filter mask word.

commands.name: Set Perf Trigger Mask
commands.description: Set a performance trigger mask word.

commands.name: Overwrite Syslog Mode
commands.description: Set syslog write mode (overwrite oldest or discard newest).

params.name: Mode
params.description: OVERWRITE: overwrite oldest entries; DISCARD: discard new entries when full

commands.name: Reset PR Count
commands.description: Reset the processor reset counter to zero.

commands.name: Set Max PR Count
commands.description: Set the maximum allowed processor reset count.

commands.name: Delete CDS
commands.description: Delete a named Critical Data Store entry.

commands.name: Send Mem Pool Stats
commands.description: Request memory pool statistics telemetry for a given pool handle.

commands.name: Dump CDS Registry
commands.description: Write the CDS registry to a file.

commands.name: Query All Tasks
commands.description: Write task info for all registered tasks to a file.

commands.name: Request HK
commands.description: Request ES housekeeping telemetry (normally sent by SCH_LAB).

commands.name: Enable Event Type
commands.description: Globally enable one or more event types.

commands.name: Disable Event Type
commands.description: Globally disable one or more event types.

commands.name: Set Event Format Mode
commands.description: Set short or long event message format.

commands.name: Enable App Event Type
commands.description: Enable event types for a specific app.

commands.name: Disable App Event Type
commands.description: Disable event types for a specific app.

commands.name: Enable App Events
commands.description: Enable all events for a specific app.

commands.name: Disable App Events
commands.description: Disable all events for a specific app.

commands.name: Reset App Event Counter
commands.description: Reset the event counter for a specific app.

commands.name: Set Filter
commands.description: Set an event filter mask for a specific app/event pair.

commands.name: Enable Ports
commands.description: Enable EVS output port(s).

commands.name: Disable Ports
commands.description: Disable EVS output port(s).

commands.name: Reset Filter
commands.description: Reset the binary event filter for a specific app/event pair.

params.name: EventID
params.description: Event ID whose filter counter is to be reset

commands.name: Reset All Filters
commands.description: Reset all event filters for a specific app.

commands.name: Add Event Filter
commands.description: Add a binary event filter for a specific app/event pair.

commands.name: Delete Event Filter
commands.description: Remove an existing binary event filter for a specific app/event pair.

params.name: EventID
params.description: Event ID whose filter is to be deleted

commands.name: Write App Data File
commands.description: Write per-app EVS data to a file.

commands.name: Write Log Data File
commands.description: Write the local event log to a file.

commands.name: Set Log Mode
commands.description: Set the EVS local event log overwrite mode.

params.name: LogMode
params.description: OVERWRITE: overwrite oldest when full; DISCARD: drop new events when full (CFE_EVS_LogMode_Enum_t)

commands.name: Clear Log
commands.description: Erase the EVS log buffer.

commands.name: Request HK
commands.description: Request EVS housekeeping telemetry (normally sent by SCH_LAB).

commands.name: Disable Route
commands.description: Disable a specific MsgId → Pipe route.

commands.name: Write Pipe Info
commands.description: Write pipe table to a file.

commands.name: Write Map Info
commands.description: Write message map to a file.

commands.name: Disable Sub Reporting

commands.description: Dump table contents to a file.

commands.description: Run validation function on a table buffer.

commands.description: Promote validated inactive buffer to active.

commands.name: Dump Registry
commands.description: Write the table registry to a file.

commands.description: Telemeter one table registry entry.

commands.description: Delete a critical table's CDS entry (table must be unregistered first).

params.description: Full table name whose CDS is to be deleted

commands.name: Abort Load
commands.description: Discard a pending (not yet activated) table load.

commands.name: Set Source

commands.name: Add Delay

commands.description: Subtract a continuous 1 Hz STCF adjustment (applied every second).
